criteria.text: Identifies that data protection breaches are not carved out of the $500,000 liability cap in Clause 11, leaving the customer under-protected for data breach losses, and recommends a separate higher cap or carve-out.
Calculates the last date to serve non-renewal notice as 7 November 2026 (90 days before the 5 February 2027 expiry), and warns that otherwise the agreement renews for 2 years.
Identifies that the planned reorganisation may be a change of control deemed an assignment under Clause 19, requiring the counterparty's consent.
Gives the notice window as 90 days and as the date 7 November 2026, with days remaining from 7 September 2026 (61 days).
Notes that 7 November 2026 is a Saturday and that notice should be served by the preceding Business Day, 6 November 2026.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
